gate: E02-S01-E02 must show exact state, stop-reason, event-digest, ledger, and S09 deterministic-cost parity in every screened block; otherwise freeze no S11 scientific selections and stop for review.

ineligible.E02-S01-E05: retry exposure inactive under frozen actionFailure=none
ineligible.E02-S01-E07: non-executable under the preserved information boundary

utilityScore: For each candidate, take the maximum of abs(unshrunk residual-error mean)/0.02, abs(unshrunk success mean)/0.02, abs(log completion ratio)/log(1.10), and abs(log full-cost ratio)/log(1.10), then multiply by max(0.5, elastic-net selection agreement across the four endpoints and three penalties).

selection.baseRule: Select the four highest utility scores, ties by estimand ID.
selection.interactionAugmentation: Add up to two of E02-S01-E09 through E02-S01-E12 when their utility score is at least 1 and their active interaction coefficient has the same sign in elastic-net, lasso, ridge, and unshrunk analyses.
selection.coverageRule: If absent from the base selection, replace the lowest-scoring redundant candidate to include the highest-scoring architecture/coordinator candidate (E01 or E08), scheduler-involving candidate (E03, E09, or E12), and fault/continuation candidate (E04, E06, E10, E11, or E12).
selection.uncertaintyRule: Candidates with a 95% residual and success interval spanning both -0.02 and +0.02 are labelled inconclusive; they may be selected only to satisfy coverage and must be flagged for the S11 extension rule.

holdoutRule: S10 writes IDs, priorities, effect directions, and precision flags only. It does not open or summarize any confirmatory_holdout outcome.
